findings.problem: The plan changes the `ask-codex` declaration and says its describing spec will be updated, but omits `docs/specs/model-bridge.md` from both its Specs line and its concrete affected-path list. That spec defines the `ask-codex` declaration and currently states its complete command fields, so leaving it out would leave the current specification false. This also drifts from the candidate boundary, which includes the specs describing `ask-codex`.
findings.suggestion: Add `model-bridge` to the Specs line and `docs/specs/model-bridge.md` to Increment C’s affected areas; specify the required declaration-summary update and include it in Increment C verification.

summary: The plan otherwise tracks the named roadmap candidate and reviewed specs, but it omits the applicable model-bridge specification for the ask-codex change.
